name: freetoshop
description: A local-first, browser-based professional image editor.

scripts.test:browser-perf: npm run build --workspace @freetoshop/web && playwright test tests/e2e/composite-performance.spec.ts --project=chromium --workers=1
scripts.test:browser-perf:all: npm run build --workspace @freetoshop/web && playwright test tests/e2e/composite-performance.spec.ts --project=chromium --project=firefox --project=webkit --workers=1
scripts.test:ui-visual: npm run build --workspace @freetoshop/web && playwright test tests/e2e/visual-workspace.spec.ts --project=chromium --workers=1
